stories.title: Ford government’s Bill 140 gutting Ontario’s environmental rights, experts warn
stories.summary: The sweeping new bill is drawing sharp warnings from environmental advocates who say it will reverse decades of progress on environmental issues.

stories.title: Toronto’s Edey finding footing with Grizzlies
stories.summary: Zach Edey's second NBA appearance at Scotiabank Arena was a bit cheaper.

stories.title: Brampton man who pleaded guilty to murdering girlfriend, then shot himself, confined to wheelchair
stories.summary: Darnell Reid faces a mandatory life sentence after pleading guilty to murdering his girlfriend, as a judge considers when he can seek parole.

stories.title: Price leads class of 2026 into Hockey Hall of Fame
stories.summary: Carey Price first visited the Hockey Hall of Fame as a teenager.

stories.title: Jerome powers Grizzlies past undermanned Raptors
stories.summary: Ty Jerome led all scorers with 27 points as the Memphis Grizzlies topped the undermanned Toronto Raptors 118-102 on Monday.

stories.summary: Automaker Stellantis says it has officially signed an agreement with Canadian defence contractor Roshel to sell its idled Brampton, Ont., assembly plant.

stories.title: Art Gallery of Ontario to open 5-floor expansion in September 2027
stories.summary: The Toronto museum says the Dani Reiss Modern and Contemporary Gallery will display nearly 400 artworks by Indigenous, Canadian and international artists.

stories.title: ‘Absolutely disgusting’: Ford addresses Hamilton poppy drive assault
stories.summary: An assault that left an air cadet captain with life-altering injuries last week was “absolutely disgusting,” Premier Doug Ford says.

stories.title: 17 arrested, 55 charges laid in OPP child sexual exploitation investigation
